kpis.name: Sun and Earth position error against JPL Horizons
kpis.definition: Largest great-circle angle between our direction and Horizons' (quantity 4) over all cases

kpis.name: Rise and set timing error from the positions
kpis.definition: Position error converted to seconds of the body's own motion; 95th percentile over all cases, worse of Sun and Earth

kpis.name: Window-edge error from the 30-minute time step
kpis.definition: Rise and set times from the step, against a 1-minute series; 95th percentile of the absolute error, and the share of edges lost (windows shorter than a step), worst group of sites
kpis.data: 17 curated sites and 40 random polar points, 2027 (polar_sun, polar_earth, polar-random_sun, polar-random_earth)

kpis.name: Window-edge error from the 60-minute time step
kpis.definition: Rise and set times from the step, against a 1-minute series; 95th percentile of the absolute error, and the share of edges lost (windows shorter than a step), worst group of sites
kpis.data: 17 curated sites and 40 random polar points, 2027 (polar_sun, polar_earth, polar-random_sun, polar-random_earth)

kpis.name: Long-term visibility within 5 percentage points of NASA's maps (centre rule)
kpis.definition: Share of 300 random south polar points where our 18.6-year share is within 0.05 of NASA Goddard's PGDA map

kpis.name: Same go / caution / no-go class as NASA's maps (centre rule)
kpis.definition: Share of points whose long-term share falls in the same class as the map's, with the badge thresholds (Sun 0.30 / 0.70, Earth 0.10 / 0.50)

kpis.name: Long-term visibility within 5 percentage points of NASA's maps (any part rule)
kpis.definition: Share of 300 random south polar points where our 18.6-year share is within 0.05 of NASA Goddard's PGDA map

kpis.name: Same go / caution / no-go class as NASA's maps (any part rule)
kpis.definition: Share of points whose long-term share falls in the same class as the map's, with the badge thresholds (Sun 0.30 / 0.70, Earth 0.10 / 0.50)

kpis.name: Terrain uncertainty band: 80 m against 120 m LOLA grid
kpis.definition: How much the answer changes under this change of the terrain input: yes/no agreement over every minute of 2027, the median and 95th percentile shift of rise and set times, and the 95th percentile change of the yearly share (mean over the directions where there are several)
kpis.kind: bound (sensitivity, not an error against the truth)
kpis.threshold: none; shown as an uncertainty band

kpis.name: Terrain uncertainty band: site moved by one 80 m pixel (north, east, south, west)
kpis.definition: How much the answer changes under this change of the terrain input: yes/no agreement over every minute of 2027, the median and 95th percentile shift of rise and set times, and the 95th percentile change of the yearly share (mean over the directions where there are several)
kpis.kind: bound (sensitivity, not an error against the truth)
kpis.threshold: none; shown as an uncertainty band
